summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around advanced packaging and backend test overflow. The reference lane includes Amkor as the most direct US-listed OSAT context anchor. The underfollowed lane adds FormFactor, Cohu, and MKS Instruments as second-order suppliers tied to probe cards, HBM inspection/test handlers, and package-substrate / advanced-packaging process chemistry and equipment. Core hypothesis: if HBM and AI accelerator packaging consume scarce IDM/foundry backend capacity, then overflow, test intensity, probe-card complexity, and substrate-manufacturing process control can benefit one or two steps away from the obvious AI chip leaders.
